svg.text: Stewards of the Long Voyage · piece concepts, v4
Threat = safety signs, escalating in shape and colour: Notice → Caution → Warning. The people are wood. Damage is shown by how a piece sits: knocked over, then upside down.
THE THREAT · safety signs on gunmetal bases
blue disc on a base · 10 mm · health 1
yellow triangle on a base · 14 mm · health 2
thick red octagon, short pole · 20 mm · health 3
circle, triangle, octagon: the colour is a bonus.
DAMAGE STATES · by how the piece sits; all stand up again at Time passes
From above, as players see them on the board:

Rules: 1 damage knocks a Fault or Failure over; a second turns a Failure upside down; one more destroys it. Glitch (health 1) has no state. A downgraded piece is replaced standing upright: damage does not carry over.
THE PEOPLE · wood and brass (Decay: rust-brown plastic)
wooden pawn, fishbowl helmet · 16 mm · health 2
flat wooden house crests, emblem engraved · 12 mm
cracked panel lying on a base · 12 mm
ON THE BOARD · mid-turn, on every section colour (pieces at 55 %)
Print-and-play: every piece is a die-cut token with an undamaged face and a damaged face; the Failure's back face is split into its two damaged states (rotate it to show 2 damage).
